title: Fix the claim balance step
prompt: The billing pipeline's balance step gives each claim the amount still owed in `balance`. New unit tests with hand-made claims fail on it. Fix `solve(claims)` so these tests pass; it returns `claim_id`, `claim_status` and `balance`.
rules: A paid claim's balance is `billed_amount` minus `paid_amount`, but never below 0: a claim paid more than it billed has a balance of 0.
A denied claim's balance is its whole `billed_amount`, whatever `paid_amount` holds, even when it's missing.
Any other claim, including one with no status, isn't settled yet and has no balance (NULL), not 0.
hints: Run the starter on the sample and compare each status with the rules: which rows come out wrong?
Arithmetic with a missing value is missing. A denied claim doesn't need `paid_amount` at all.
Give each case its own `when`, narrowest first, and leave out `otherwise` so everything else stays NULL.
